batchDriver.source:
import pathlib,subprocess,os,sys,json,hashlib,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();out=root/'output/verification/cloud-final-108-20261105'
expected='cfe39179b8635a11a8b805ff127e9cc230a35e21296ba4996be4e7ce363df93d'
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def archive(label):
 folder=out/'artifacts';folder.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True);blobs=folder/'blobs';blobs.mkdir(mode=0o700,exist_ok=True)
 target=folder/(label+'.json');assert not target.exists(),label
 files=[]
 for relative in ['output/playwright','output/verification/cloud-ui']:
  directory=root/relative
  if not directory.exists():continue
  for path in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
   assert not path.is_symlink(),str(path)
   if not path.is_file():continue
   data=path.read_bytes();digest=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest();blob=blobs/(digest+path.suffix)
   if not blob.exists():
    with blob.open('xb') as handle:handle.write(data)
    blob.chmod(0o400)
   else:assert hashlib.sha256(blob.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
   files.append({'source':str(path.relative_to(root)),'sha256':digest,'bytes':len(data),'blob':str(blob.relative_to(root))})
 target.write_text(json.dumps({'capturedAt':now(),'label':label,'files':files},indent=2)+'\n');target.chmod(0o400)
 print('ARTIFACTS_ARCHIVED '+label+' '+str(len(files)),flush=True)
def fingerprint(label):
 target=out/('candidate.'+label+'.json');assert not target.exists()
 code="import {candidateFingerprint} from './support/acceptance/candidate.js';import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';const c=await candidateFingerprint();await writeFile(process.argv[1],JSON.stringify(c,null,2));console.log(c.sha256)"
 actual=subprocess.check_output(['node','--input-type=module','-e',code,str(target)],text=True).strip();assert actual==expected,(label,actual);target.chmod(0o400)
 print('FINGERPRINT '+label+' '+actual,flush=True)
def execute(name,args,timeout=900):
 assert not os.environ.get('NODE_OPTIONS')
 assert not (out/(name+'.log')).exists() and not (out/(name+'.watchdog.json')).exists(),name
 archive('before-'+name)
 env=os.environ.copy()
 if name=='verify':env['PARDNER_CLOUD_FIXTURE_REPORT']=str(out/'fixture-traces-verify.json')
 print('START '+name+' '+now(),flush=True)
 result=subprocess.run(['node','scripts/verify-watchdog.js','--timeout',str(timeout),'--log',str(out/(name+'.log')),'--record',str(out/(name+'.watchdog.json')),'--',*args],env=env)
 archive('after-'+name)
 record=json.load(open(out/(name+'.watchdog.json')))
 for suffix in ['.log','.watchdog.json']:(out/(name+suffix)).chmod(0o400)
 print('END '+name+' '+str(result.returncode)+' '+now(),flush=True)
 if result.returncode:sys.exit(result.returncode)
 assert not record['survivorsAfterKill'] and not record['newScratch'] and not record['timedOut'],name
if sys.argv[1]=='routine':
 archive('initial')
 execute('environment',['node',str(out/'environment.mjs')])
 execute('policy',['python3',str(out/'policy-check.py')])
 execute('build',['npm','run','ui:build'])
 fingerprint('before')
 execute('browser-launch',['node','--input-type=module','-e',"import {chromium,webkit} from 'playwright'; for(const engine of [chromium,webkit]){const b=await engine.launch({headless:true});console.log(engine.name(),b.version());await b.close()}"])
 execute('ui',['npm','run','test:ui']);fingerprint('after-ui')
 execute('verify',['npm','run','verify']);fingerprint('after-routine')
 print('FRESH_ROUTINE_COMPLETE',flush=True)
elif sys.argv[1]=='gate':
 fingerprint('before-gate')
 execute('qualification',['npm','run','test:acceptance','--','--repeat','20','--seed','1'],3600)
 fingerprint('after');print('GATE_COMPLETE',flush=True)
else:raise ValueError('Unknown batch')
